Callout.Name: Barn Fire
Callout.Message: Barn alight on farmland, livestock inside.
Callout.Advisory: Owner on scene, animals still inside, no persons hurt.

Script.Line: It went up in the hay. Hay goes fast, everybody knows that.
There is a heifer in the end bay and I cannot get to her.
I have been stood here twenty minutes and it has doubled.

Lines.Approach: The barn is well alight and there are animals in it. The owner is trying to get them out themselves.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
